newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Stanbic sees improved rate of growth in H2.
newsitem.headline: Stanbic sees improved rate of growth in H2.

text.p: South Africa's Standard Bank Investment Corp Ltd (Stanbic) said on Tuesday it expected to see a better rate of growth in the second half of the year.
The firm earlier posted an increase in half year headline earnings per share to 693 cents from 602 cents.

"A lower level of debt provisioning and an improvement in interest margins should enable the group to achieve a better rate of growth in headline earnings for the second half of the year," the firm said.
Stanbic said it expected money market conditions in the second half to show an improvement, but growth in non-interest income was not expected to continue at the same high rate as in the first half.
